thread:
kelly_sales: Quick ask - HarborTrust (regulated/private deployment) requesting a special onboarding structure. Deal: 12mo Dedicated commit (~$390k ARR) + 24/7 managed support. Sales request: convert $18k of PS discount into credits spread across the first two invoices instead of a single one-off. Rationale: customer accounting prefers small recurring credits. Approvals?

sam_finance: Need the PS SOW and breakdown. Also prefer credits applied as a one-time invoice line vs recurring MRR adjustments. Spreading credits can complicate revenue recognition.

kelly_sales: SOW uploaded in Deal Desk (link). PS estimate: ~260 hours of eng/SRE (~$32k internal cost). Customer pays $14k PS; gap = $18k. They want credits applied $9k on invoice 1 and $9k on invoice 2.

esther_revops: RevOps notes: we can post two one-time credits; need to map to correct SKUs and GLs. Which revenue code should be used for split credits? Also need to confirm tax treatment.

lucas_cs: CS: we'll provide the onboarding rotations and audit evidence. No objection to split credits but need clear milestone acceptance in SOW to avoid disputes.

neha_legal: Legal: fine with split credits, but require an amendment that states exact schedule of credits, acceptance milestones, and a 120-day clawback if they churn or materially reduce committed capacity. We prefer a clawback period aligned with our revenue recognition.

tom_cfo: From finance POV, I can accept split credits up to $15k total without further review. Anything above $15k requires Exec Finance review. Also require RevOps ledger entries and tax review.

kelly_sales: Customer insists $18k split. If finance only permits $15k should we offer $15k + discounted PS rate to bridge?

sam_finance: Suggestion: approve up to $15k split credit ($7.5k + $7.5k), and offer a one-time PS discount of $3k if we need to reach $18k; classify the $3k as PS fee reduction (billable) not as credit. That keeps revenue recognition clean. Conditions: RevOps entries, Legal addendum with 120-day clawback, and CS milestone signoff.

esther_revops: I'll prepare the two one-time credit ledger entries and coordinate tax team. Put GL 4310 for credits and include note referencing the Deal Desk ticket.

neha_legal: I'll draft the amendment and include the split schedule and clawback. Expect draft in 2 business days. If customer needs kickoff sooner we can use provisional SOW with conditional credit language.

lucas_cs: I'll add milestone acceptance criteria to the SOW and confirm CS staffing.

kelly_sales: Ok marking as "conditional approval": up to $15k split credit (two one-time credits), plus optional $3k PS discount if needed (PS billing line). Will notify customer and escalate to @tom_cfo if they insist on full $18k as credit.

ops-bot: NOTE: provisional kickoff tentatively scheduled for 2026-04-09 pending executed amendment and RevOps ledger entries.
